Tafsir Surah Tabbat: Badtareen aur badnaseeb miyan biwi:

Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Batha mein ja kar ek pahari par charh gaye aur unchi aawaz se "Ya Sabaha, Ya Sabaha" kehne lage. Quraish sab jama ho gaye toh Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya agar main tum se kahoon ke subh ya sham dushman tum par chhapa maarne wala hai toh kya tum mujhe sacha samjho ge? Sab ne jawab diya ji haan. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya suno main tumhein Allah ke sakht azab ke aane ki khabar de raha hoon toh Abu Lahab kehne laga tujhe halakat ho, kya isi liye tu ne hamein jama kiya tha? Is par yeh Surah utri (Bukhari).

Dusri riwayat mein hai ke yeh hath jharhta hua yun kehta hua uth khara hua. "Tabbat" bad-dua hai aur "Tabb" khabar hai, yeh Abu Lahab An-Hazrat (ﷺ) ka chacha tha is ka naam Abdul Uzza bin Abdul Muttalib tha. Is ki kuniyat Abu Utbah thi. Is ke chehre ki khubsurti aur chamak damak ki wajah se ise Abu Lahab yani sholay wala kaha jata tha, yeh Huzoor (ﷺ) ka badtareen dushman tha har waqt eza-dahi, takleef rasani aur nuqsan pohanchane ke darpay raha karta tha.

Rabiah bin Abbad Deeli apne Islam lane ke baad apna jahiliyat ka waqia bayan karte hain ke main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ko khud Zul-Majaz ke bazar mein dekha ke Aap (ﷺ) farma rahe hain logo "La ilaha illallah" kaho toh falah pao ge. Logo ka majma Aap (ﷺ) ke aas paas laga hua tha. Main ne dekha ke Aap (ﷺ) ke peeche hi ek goray chittay chamaktay chehray wala, bhengi aankh wala jis ke sar ke baray baalon ki do mendhiyan thin, aaya aur kehne laga logo yeh be-deen hai, jhoota hai. Garz Aap (ﷺ) logo ke majmay mein ja kar Allah ki tauheed ki dawat dete thay aur yeh dushman peeche peeche yeh kehta hua chala ja raha tha. Main ne logo se poocha yeh kaun hai? Logo ne kaha yeh Aap (ﷺ) ka chacha Abu Lahab hai (La'nahullah) (Musnad Ahmad).

Abu Zinad ne rawi-e-hadith Hazrat Rabiah se kaha ke aap toh us waqt bacha honge? Farmaya nahin main us waqt khasi umar ka tha, mashk laad kar pani bhar laya karta tha. Dusri riwayat mein hai main apne baap ke sath tha meri jawan umar thi aur main ne dekha ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ek ek qabeelay ke paas jate aur farmate logo main tumhari taraf Allah ka Rasool bana kar bheja gaya hoon, main tum se kehta hoon ke ek Allah hi ki ibadat karo aur us ke sath kisi ko shareek na karo, mujhe sacha jano, mujhe mere dushmano se bachao taake main us ka kaam baja laoon jis ka hukm mujhe de kar Allah Ta'ala ne bheja hai. Aap (ﷺ) yeh paigham pohancha kar farigh hote toh Aap (ﷺ) ka chacha Abu Lahab peeche se pohanchta aur kehta ae falan qabeelay ke logo! Yeh shakhs toh tumhein Laat-o-Uzza se hatana chahta hai aur Banu Malik bin Aqeesh ke tumhare haleef jinno se tumhein door kar raha hai aur apni nayi layi hui gumrahi ki taraf tumhein bhi ghaseet raha hai, khabardar na is ki sunna na manna (Ahmad-o-Tabrani).

Allah Ta'ala is Surah mein farmata hai ke Abu Lahab barbad hua, us ki koshish gharat hui, us ke aamal halak hue, bil-yaqeen us ki barbadi ho chuki, us ki aulad us ke kaam na aayi.

Ab Mas'ood R.A farmate hain ke jab Rasool Allah ﷺ ne apni qoum ko Allah ki taraf bulaya toh Abu Lahab kehne laga agar mere bhatije ki baatein haq hain toh main Qayamat ke din apna maal-o-aulad Allah ko fidiya mein de kar is ke azaab se chhoot jaunga, is par aayat 'Ma aghna...' utri. Phir farmaya ke yeh sholay maarne wali aag mein jo sakht jalane wali aur bahut tez hai dakhil hoga, aur is ki biwi bhi jo Quraish aurton ki sardar thi, is ki kuniyat Umm-e-Jameel thi, naam Arwa tha, Harb bin Umayyah ki ladki thi, Abu Sufyan ki behen thi aur apne khawand ke kufr-o-inaad aur sarkashi-o-dushmani mein yeh bhi is ke saath thi, isi liye Qayamat ke din azaabon mein bhi isi ke saath hogi. Ladkiyan utha utha kar layegi aur jis aag mein is ka khawand jal raha hoga dalti jayegi, is ke gale mein aag ki rassi hogi aur Jahannam ka indhan samet-ti rahegi. Yeh ma'ani bhi kiye gaye hain ke 'Hammalat-al-Hatab' se murad is ka ghaib go hona hai, Imam Ibn-e-Jareer isi ko pasand karte hain, Ibn-e-Abbas R.A waghera ne yeh matlab bayan kiya hai ke yeh jungle se khar-dar lakdiyan chun lati thi aur Nabi-e-Akram ﷺ ki raah mein bicha diya karti thi. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke chunke yeh aurat Nabi ﷺ ko faqiri ka ta'ana diya karti thi toh ise is ka lakdiyan chunna yaad dilaya gaya, lekin sahih qaul pehla hi hai, Wallahu A'alam.

Saeed bin Musayyab R.H farmate hain ke is ke paas ek nafees haar tha, kehti thi ke ise main farokht kar ke Muhammad ﷺ ki mukhalifat mein kharch karungi, toh yahan farmaya gaya ke is ke badle is ke gale mein aag ka tauq dala jayega. 'Masad' ke ma'ani khajoor ki rassi ke hain. Hazrat Urwah R.A farmate hain yeh Jahannam ki zanjeer hai jis ki ek ek kadi sattar sattar gaz ki hai. Thauri R.H farmate hain yeh Jahannam ka tauq hai jis ki lambai sattar haath hai. Jauhari R.H farmate hain yeh oont ki khaal ki aur oont ke baalon ki banayi jati hai. Mujahid R.H farmate hain yani lohay ka tauq.

Hazrat Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa R.A ka bayan hai ke jab yeh Surah utri toh yeh bhengi aurat Umm-e-Jameel bint-e-Harb apne haath mein nok-dar patthar liye yun kehti hui Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aayi: "Muzammam (mazmoom) ko hum ne na-pasand kiya, is ke deen ke dushman hain aur is ke nafarman hain." Is waqt Rasool Allah ﷺ Ka'aba-tullah mein baithe hue thay, aap ke saath mere walid Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.A bhi thay. Siddiq-e-Akbar R.A ne ise is halat mein dekh kar Huzoor ﷺ se arz kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ! Yeh aa rahi hai, aisa na ho aap ko dekh le. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya, "Siddiq! Be-gham raho, yeh mujhe nahin dekh sakti." Phir aap ﷺ ne Quran-e-Kareem ki tilawat shuru kar di taake is se bach jayen. Khud Quran farmata hai: "Wa iza qara'tal Qur'ana ja'alna bainaka wa bainallazeena la yu'minoona bil-akhirati hijaban mastoora" (17:45), yani jab tu Quran padhta hai toh hum tere aur imaan na lane walon ke darmiyan posheeda parday daal dete hain. Yeh dain aa kar Hazrat Abu Bakr R.A ke paas khadi ho gayi, jabke Huzoor ﷺ bhi Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar R.A ke paas hi bilkul zahir baithe hue thay, lekin qudrati hijabon ne is ki aankhon par parda daal diya, woh Huzoor ﷺ ko na dekh saki.

Hazrat Abu Bakr R.A ne farmaya nahin nahin Rabb-ul-Bait ki qasam Huzoor ﷺ ne teri koi hajv nahin ki, toh yeh kehti hui laut gayi ke Quraish jaante hain ke main unke sardar ki beti hoon (Ibn Abi Hatim). Ek martaba yeh apni lambi chadar odhe tawaf kar rahi thi, pair chadar mein ulajh gaya aur phisal padi toh kehne lagi Muzammam gharat ho. Umm-e-Hakim bint-e-Abdul Muttalib ne kaha main toh pak daman aurat hoon apni zaban nahin bigadungi aur dost pasand hoon pas daagh na lagaungi aur hum saare ek hi dada ki aulad mein se hain aur Quraish hi zyada janne wale hain. Bazzar mein hai ke usne Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.A se kaha ke tere saathi ne meri hajv ki hai, toh Hazrat Siddiq ne qasam kha kar jawab diya ke na toh Aap ﷺ sher-goi jaante hain na kabhi Aap ﷺ ne sher kahe. Uske jaane ke baad Hazrat Siddiq ne Huzoor ﷺ se daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ kya usne Aap ﷺ ko dekha nahin? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya farishta aad ban kar khada hua tha jab tak woh wapas chali na gayi. Baaz ahl-e-ilm ne kaha hai ke uske gale mein jahannam ki aag ki rassi hogi jisse use khench kar jahannam ke upar laya jayega phir dheeli chhod kar jahannam ki teh mein pahunchaya jayega, yahi azab use hota rahega. Dol ki rassi ko Arab masad keh diya karte hain. Arabi sher-on mein bhi yeh lafz isi ma'ani mein laya gaya hai. Haan yeh yaad rahe ke yeh babarkat surat hamare Nabi ﷺ ki nabuwwat ki ek aala daleel hai kyunke jis tarah unki badbakhti ki khabar is surat mein di gayi thi isi tarah waqia bhi hua, un dono ko iman lana aakhir tak naseeb hi na hua, na toh woh zahir mein musalman hue na batin mein, na chhupe na khule. Pas yeh surat zabardast bahut saaf aur roshan daleel hai Huzoor ﷺ ki nabuwwat ki. Is surat ki tafsir bhi khatam hui. Allah hi ke liye sab tareefein hain aur usi ke fazl-o-karam aur usi ke ehsan-o-inaam ki yeh barkat hai.

Thauri R.H farmate hain yeh Jahannam ka tauq hai jis ki lambai sattar haath hai. Jauhari R.H farmate hain yeh oont ki khaal ki aur oont ke baalon ki banayi jati hai. Mujahid R.H farmate hain yani lohay ka tauq.

Is waqt Rasool Allah ﷺ Ka'aba-tullah mein baithe hue thay, aap ke saath mere walid Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.A bhi thay. Be-gham raho, yeh mujhe nahin dekh sakti." Phir aap ﷺ ne Quran-e-Kareem ki tilawat shuru kar di taake is se bach jayen. Bazzar mein hai ke usne Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.A se kaha ke tere saathi ne meri hajv ki hai, toh Hazrat Siddiq ne qasam kha kar jawab diya ke na toh Aap ﷺ sher-goi jaante hain na kabhi Aap ﷺ ne sher kahe. Uske jaane ke baad Hazrat Siddiq ne Huzoor ﷺ se daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ kya usne Aap ﷺ ko dekha nahin? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya farishta aad ban kar khada hua tha jab tak woh wapas chali na gayi. Baaz ahl-e-ilm ne kaha hai ke uske gale mein jahannam ki aag ki rassi hogi jisse use khench kar jahannam ke upar laya jayega phir dheeli chhod kar jahannam ki teh mein pahunchaya jayega, yahi azab use hota rahega. Dol ki rassi ko Arab masad keh diya karte hain. Arabi sher-on mein bhi yeh lafz isi ma'ani mein laya gaya hai. Allah hi ke liye sab tareefein hain aur usi ke fazl-o-karam aur usi ke ehsan-o-inaam ki yeh barkat hai.

Ek martaba yeh apni lambi chadar odhe tawaf kar rahi thi, pair chadar mein ulajh gaya aur phisal padi toh kehne lagi Muzammam gharat ho. Umm-e-Hakim bint-e-Abdul Muttalib ne kaha main toh pak daman aurat hoon apni zaban nahin bigadungi aur dost pasand hoon pas daagh na lagaungi aur hum saare ek hi dada ki aulad mein se hain aur Quraish hi zyada janne wale hain. Bazzar mein hai ke usne Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.A se kaha ke tere saathi ne meri hajv ki hai, toh Hazrat Siddiq ne qasam kha kar jawab diya ke na toh Aap ﷺ sher-goi jaante hain na kabhi Aap ﷺ ne sher kahe. Uske jaane ke baad Hazrat Siddiq ne Huzoor ﷺ se daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ kya usne Aap ﷺ ko dekha nahin? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya farishta aad ban kar khada hua tha jab tak woh wapas chali na gayi. Baaz ahl-e-ilm ne kaha hai ke uske gale mein jahannam ki aag ki rassi hogi jisse use khench kar jahannam ke upar laya jayega phir dheeli chhod kar jahannam ki teh mein pahunchaya jayega, yahi azab use hota rahega. Dol ki rassi ko Arab masad keh diya karte hain. Arabi sher-on mein bhi yeh lafz isi ma'ani mein laya gaya hai. Haan yeh yaad rahe ke yeh babarkat surat hamare Nabi ﷺ ki nabuwwat ki ek aala daleel hai kyunke jis tarah unki badbakhti ki khabar is surat mein di gayi thi isi tarah waqia bhi hua, un dono ko iman lana aakhir tak naseeb hi na hua, na toh woh zahir mein musalman hue na batin mein, na chhupe na khule. Pas yeh surat zabardast bahut saaf aur roshan daleel hai Huzoor ﷺ ki nabuwwat ki. Is surat ki tafsir bhi khatam hui. Allah hi ke liye sab tareefein hain aur usi ke fazl-o-karam aur usi ke ehsan-o-inaam ki yeh barkat hai.
